findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score support is the discrete window 0.0-0.49 with learning window 0.0-0.5 and curve support 0.0-0.49; recorded affinities were removed and replaced by an equal score prior, so no observed affinity label is available to score coordinate hypotheses against.

Continuous contrast features are represented as predicted endpoint world-A features, not physical interaction energies; landmark_00_soft_mass shows a whole-window z of 0.64 with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts, so these curves are not stable constant rules across the observed support.

Several landmark_00 local derivative features have large first-rate and last-rate z values of opposite sign (e.g. local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative and last_rate_z positive; local_cyy first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), which is consistent with time-conditioned rather than constant contrast behavior, but polynomial fits were not accepted and extrapolation is disallowed.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast rather than constant contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: A validated fit with no sign changes and stable rate across the observed window would contradict this.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 local contrast features over observed score nodes 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes may change sign within the observed window, so a time-conditioned contrast rule could differ in direction from a constant whole-window rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: Joint diagnostics showing no coupling beyond marginal effects would contradict this.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 soft mass and local second-moment features
hypotheses.statement: Isolated marginal landmark descriptors may be redundant or coupled, so coherent joint coordinate patterns could carry different priority than single-feature point estimates.

limitations: No observed affinity labels are available (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so final predicted target affinity benefit cannot be evaluated from the supplied evidence.
No decoded terminal labels or outcome evaluation data for the current study were supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Continuous trend fits were not accepted as polynomials and extrapolation is disallowed; only observed-node interpolation within 0.0-0.49 is supported.

Uncertainty, multiplicity-adjusted support, coverage, covariance, intact-conformation and turnover-residual tables were not read in this turn, so ranking under multiplicity adjustment and within-path versus cohort-composition comparisons remain unsupported here.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Use these observations to provide your response to the supplied molecular coordinate task.
